subject: general
question:
Identify whether the following statements are true or false with reference to MS-Word 2010.

(i) A template can be selected while creating a new document.

(ii) The keyboard shortcut for going to the end of a document is Shift + End.
solution:
The correct answer is __**(i) True (ii) False.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A template can be selected while creating a new document, t*his statement is true.***
 
• **MS Word 2010 **provides** numerous templates** that can be used when creating a new document.
 
• These templates, be it for **resumes, letters, reports, etc.**, present a premade format that users can** utilize and modify as per their requirements.**
 
• **The keyboard shortcut for going to the end of a document is Shift + End, t*his statement is false.***
 
• In MS Word 2010, the **"Shift + End"** keyboard shortcut is used to** select text from the cursor to the end of the line.**
 
• If you want **to reach the end of the document swiftly**, you use the **"Ctrl + End" **keyboard shortcut.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
